scope: Opaque key previews above candidates; stable toolbar/symbol top spacing and correct initial input-view height.

rootCause.preview: A key raised its preview above the header, then keyboard layout raised the header above the held preview. Candidate text painted over the already-opaque background. Reproduced by candidate publication and relayout during a held Q press.
rootCause.topSpacing: Normal toolbar used a center-based inset (10.75 pt by default); symbol close/picker used y=0/2. There was no common top spacing. Also the extension initially requested a fixed 272 pt without saved factor/footer and corrected it only later.
rootCause.intermittentExternalPadding: Not reproduced under automated host presentation. The simulator did not present its software keyboard in the attempted native input-view probe. Do not equate attached-view tests with real extension host validation.

changes.preview: Dedicated noninteractive previewOverlay with zPosition=1, raised last on layout. Weak key reference to overlay. Explicit alpha=1 and solid background. Compact first-row preview stays within own input-view bounds.
changes.spacing: KeyboardMetrics.toolbarTopInset=8 shared by main toolbar and symbol controls; remains constant through saved height changes and panel reopen.
changes.initialHeight: Extension seeds footer and globe requirement before preferred-height constraint; no repeated constant update when unchanged. Sandbox input view also starts at actual saved preferred height.

coverage: Held opaque preview across candidate publication and layout
Symbol top inset across height resize and panel reopen
Existing panel exclusivity and symbol exit
Native 70-key burst/interleaved input, immediate marked text, latest sentence
Initial extension height matches saved preference/footer, repeated layout stable

validation.localVisualChecks: Opaque preview over candidates and fixed symbol top spacing inspected. Screenshots kept only in local xcresult/tmp; no screenshot added to Git.
validation.device: Not run for this UI change: iPhone unavailable. Prior correction-device tests remain valid for unchanged engine semantics; they do not validate this new UI.

release.build: in progress after final height initialization refinement
